method_change: Ordnance Survey UPRN point identifier -> Ordnance Survey authoritative UPRN/TOID/USRN relationship lookup with explicit no-spatial-information semantics
first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. Ordnance Survey's official OS Open Linked Identifiers product provides authoritative relationships between UPRNs, USRNs and TOIDs, including address-to-building-footprint identifier linkage, but the official getting-started guide states that the CSV lookup files do not contain spatial information. Identifier linkage alone cannot be promoted to canonical parcel/title geometry or bbox. Local OpenCode must bind the target-specific BUILDING_PRESENT record and linked identifiers to a canonical parcel/title polygon; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The official Ordnance Survey OS Open Linked Identifiers product is a materially different identifier-linkage method from the prior OS Open UPRN point dataset. It can authoritatively relate UPRNs to OS MasterMap TOIDs and other identifiers, including building-footprint relationships, but its official getting-started guide explicitly states that the CSV files contain no spatial information. It therefore cannot by itself supply a cadastral/title parcel polygon or canonical parcel bbox. No target-specific canonical parcel binding exists in the verified lineage, so accepted/materialized/direct parcel counts remain zero and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
next_modified_method: Do not reuse this OS Open Linked Identifiers product/guide window or identifier-linkage method. Resume only from local OpenCode target-specific canonical parcel binding or another unused official public no-login source that directly supplies target-specific parcel/title polygon geometry; then open one unused bbox-scoped official DEM/LIDAR tile/index window.
